components.description: Storybook-only Foundations page for the typography scale. Enumerates the .mud-{desktop|mobile}-* type classes loaded in the preview (.storybook/design-tokens.scss), renders a specimen in each, reads its declared size/weight/line-height/letter-spacing, and copies the class name on click. The Desktop/Mobile toggle switches which scale is shown.
